presets.label: ALCF Metis (Globus Auth)
presets.description: Argonne's Metis inference gateway (FastCoE 'api' framework, OpenAI-compatible chat-completions). Useful fallback when Sophia is in maintenance; typically loads gpt-oss-120b and Llama-4-Maverick. Same Globus tokens as Sophia/Polaris.
presets.status_message: stored Globus token could not be refreshed; authenticate ALCF

presets.label: ALCF Sophia (Globus Auth)
presets.description: Argonne's Sophia inference gateway (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible). Auth is a Globus access token minted on demand from the user's anl.gov / alcf.anl.gov identity. Run `python -m clio_agent.providers.argonne_auth authenticate` once per machine; tokens auto-refresh.
presets.status_message: stored Globus token could not be refreshed; authenticate ALCF

presets.label: Anthropic API
presets.description: Direct Anthropic API. Requires an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

presets.label: Claude Code (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `claude` CLI (`claude -p`) so calls use Claude Code subscription auth instead of direct Anthropic API keys. Requires Claude Code on PATH and `claude login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM with Claude Code tools disabled.
presets.status_message: claude CLI available

presets.label: LM Studio (localhost)
presets.description: Locally-hosted models via LM Studio. Clear the model field to auto-discover the loaded model from /v1/models.

presets.label: Ollama (localhost)
presets.description: Locally-hosted models via Ollama.

presets.label: OpenAI / ChatGPT
presets.description: Direct OpenAI API (powers ChatGPT + Codex CLI). Requires an OPENAI_API_KEY. Defaults to gpt-4o-mini for low cost; swap in gpt-4o or gpt-4-turbo for heavier work.

presets.label: OpenAI Codex (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `codex` CLI (`codex exec`) so calls hit your ChatGPT / Codex subscription instead of paying per-token on the OpenAI API. Requires the Codex CLI on PATH and `codex login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM - no HTTP bridge process needed.
presets.status_message: codex CLI available

presets.label: OpenRouter
presets.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway over many providers. Free tier models (suffixed :free) work without spend but are heavily rate-limited.

presets.label: vLLM (localhost)
presets.description: Any local OpenAI-compatible vLLM server. No Globus needed; the server commonly accepts the literal 'EMPTY' API key. Override api_base with the bound port.

agent_blueprint.title: Genomics Review Agent
agent_blueprint.description: Reviews small reference FASTA and VCF variant files for collaborator handoff.

metadata.body:
# Genomics Review Agent

A domain agent for small genomics handoff reviews. It separates reference
inspection, reference quality, variant review, and variant impact triage so
CLIO can test per-session agent activation with a hierarchy that is not the
default data-exploration agent.

agent_blueprint.title: Genomics Review Agent
agent_blueprint.description: Reviews small reference FASTA and VCF variant files for collaborator handoff.

metadata.body:
# Genomics Review Agent

A domain agent for small genomics handoff reviews. It separates reference
inspection, reference quality, variant review, and variant impact triage so
CLIO can test per-session agent activation with a hierarchy that is not the
default data-exploration agent.

Observed VCF: `/tmp/clio-09-readiness/tmp/clio-benchmark-data/pathogen_sample_variants.vcf`.

Summary:
- 6 variants total across `chrA` and `plasmidB`.
- SNVs: `var001` `A>G` in `repA`, missense, `PASS`, QUAL 72.0; `var004` `T>C` in `hypothetical`, synonymous, `LowQual`, QUAL 22.1; `var005` `C>T` in `resistance`, stop_gained, `PASS`, QUAL 88.4.
- Deletions: `var002` `CT>C` in `membrane`, annotated frameshift, `PASS`, QUAL 54.5; `var006` `GTA>G` in `mobility`, annotated deletion, `PASS`, QUAL 47.3.
- Insertion: `var003` `G>GA` in `polymerase`, annotated insertion, `PASS`, QUAL 61.2.
- All records show `GT:DP` as `0/1:42` for `sample_A`.

Likely effects:
- Highest-priority biological follow-up: `var005` stop gained in `resistance`.
- Potentially disruptive coding changes: `var002` frameshift and `var003`/`var006` indels.
- Lower priority or caution: `var004` is synonymous but marked `LowQual`.

Verify before downstream analysis:
- Confirm the reference assembly and contig definitions for `chrA` and `plasmidB`; the VCF does not include `##contig` metadata.
- Confirm gene/effect annotations are from a trusted annotation workflow, since they are synthetic labels in INFO.
- Review `LowQual` handling, especially whether to exclude `var004`.
- Confirm pathogen ploidy/genotyping assumptions; all calls are `0/1`, which may be unexpected for haploid organisms.
- Validate depth and sample metadata; every variant has `DP=42`, which may indicate synthetic or normalized benchmark data.
- Check VCF completeness: FORMAT metadata for `GT` and `DP` is not declared in the header.

presets.label: Anthropic API

from genomics and geospatial agents.

presets.label: Ollama (localhost)

presets.label: OpenAI / ChatGPT
presets.description: Direct OpenAI API (powers ChatGPT + Codex CLI). Requires an OPENAI_API_KEY. Defaults to gpt-4o-mini for low cost; swap in gpt-4o or gpt-4-turbo for heavier work.

presets.label: OpenAI Codex (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `codex` CLI (`codex exec`) so calls hit your ChatGPT / Codex subscription instead of paying per-token on the OpenAI API. Requires the Codex CLI on PATH and `codex login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM - no HTTP bridge process needed.
presets.status_message: codex CLI available

presets.label: OpenRouter
presets.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway over many providers. Free tier models (suffixed :free) work without spend but are heavily rate-limited.

presets.label: vLLM (localhost)
presets.description: Any local OpenAI-compatible vLLM server. No Globus needed; the server commonly accepts the literal 'EMPTY' API key. Override api_base with the bound port.

presets.label: Anthropic API
presets.description: Direct Anthropic API. Requires an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

presets.label: Claude Code (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `claude` CLI (`claude -p`) so calls use Claude Code subscription auth instead of direct Anthropic API keys. Requires Claude Code on PATH and `claude login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM with Claude Code tools disabled.

presets.label: LM Studio (localhost)
presets.description: Locally-hosted models via LM Studio. Clear the model field to auto-discover the loaded model from /v1/models.

presets.label: Ollama (localhost)
presets.description: Locally-hosted models via Ollama.

presets.label: OpenAI / ChatGPT
presets.description: Direct OpenAI API (powers ChatGPT + Codex CLI). Requires an OPENAI_API_KEY. Defaults to gpt-4o-mini for low cost; swap in gpt-4o or gpt-4-turbo for heavier work.

presets.label: OpenAI Codex (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `codex` CLI (`codex exec`) so calls hit your ChatGPT / Codex subscription instead of paying per-token on the OpenAI API. Requires the Codex CLI on PATH and `codex login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM - no HTTP bridge process needed.
presets.status_message: codex CLI available

presets.label: OpenRouter
presets.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway over many providers. Free tier models (suffixed :free) work without spend but are heavily rate-limited.

presets.label: vLLM (localhost)
presets.description: Any local OpenAI-compatible vLLM server. No Globus needed; the server commonly accepts the literal 'EMPTY' API key. Override api_base with the bound port.

metadata.body:
# Seismic Waveform Review Agent

A seismic-domain agent that preserves the intended hierarchy:
orchestrator to data, data to catalog child, return to data, then analysis to
SAC child, return to analysis, then visualization.

The NDP catalog child is loaded through the reusable pack-local
`modules/ndp-collector/experts` include so this pack exercises CLIO's Agent
Blueprint subtree composition semantics.
